title: Principled Personas: Defining and Measuring the Intended Effects of Persona Prompting on Task Performance
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the task performance of Large Language Models when using persona prompts across various domains like math and reasoning. While it includes a 'Philosophy' sub-category from the MMLU-Pro benchmark and discusses 'normative' claims for persona design, it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral systems, or ethical frameworks as a primary component of the study.
